l_description: My name is Bisola Akintunde and I’m an incoming 11th grade student at Strathcona high School. I am a Windsor Park and Crestwood junior High Alumni. I am a recent winner of the Teen Dream global competition in which I have to share my dream and implement it. My dream is to start FGEN (Future Generation) in which I share information about the brain to students. I have a passion for neuroscience in which I would love to spread to the upcoming generation in a fun way. I believe that one of the best impacts I can make is inspiring the future generations and this is what FGEN is for!
